name: Nana Hoot
personality: wise, warm, patient, gently funny; gives advice with a story. FUNNY: her glasses keep slipping down her beak; hoots 'Hoo-hoo-HOO!' when she laughs; sometimes falls asleep mid-sentence and wakes with 'I'm awake!'
look: plump brown owl with cream face disc, ear tufts, round gold glasses, lilac knitted shawl, orange feet
